channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Norway’s FM tells Al Jazeera the US war on Iran was not ‘smart’
item.description: Norway’s FM Espen Barth Eide says the Iran war failed to achieve its initial aims and strengthened hardliners in Tehran.

item.title: UAE accuses Iran of attacks on two ADNOC vessels in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: No injuries were reported in the attack, which the UAE called 'piracy' and a threat to global energy security.

item.title: Yemen faces highest risk of returning to war since 2022 truce, UN warns
item.description: Civilian and military casualties have been reported as fighting has flared across Yemeni front lines in recent days.

item.title: Iran war live: US eyes indefinite Iran naval blockade
item.description: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth says the US can sustain its blockade against Iran 'indefinitely'.

item.title: Gaza City police chief killed as Israel pushes on with deadly strikes
item.description: Latest Israeli attacks kill police official Jamal Abu Kamil in Gaza City and another person in Khan Younis.

item.title: Israeli strikes in Gaza kill two, including police chief
item.description: Israeli drone strikes killed at least 2 people and wounded several others in Gaza on Thursday.

item.title: Palestinians told to leave homes in village where Israeli settlers besieged houses
item.description: The mayor of Qusra says Israeli troops have been telling families to leave their houses, using some as barracks.

item.title: Romania shuts only nuclear plant as heat causes huge drop in Danube River level
item.description: The Cernavodă plant, which produces 20% of Romania's electricity, is not expected to be restarted within the next 10 days.

item.title: Israeli settlers besieging Palestinian families in West Bank village
item.description: Israeli security forces have reportedly withdrawn and about a dozen settlers are said to remain at the site where two families have been besieged since Sunday.

item.title: Iran has shaken Trump's support - is his loyal base sticking with him?
item.description: Munitions for the war are made in Kingsport, Tennessee, where some of the president's most loyal supporters are wrestling with higher prices.
